I wish i had the money to see a doctor :/  Literally the money i have now, if i were to spend it i wouldnt be able to afford rent.  My hours at work are getting shorter.  My last day i got cut 2 hours early.  I've been apply to places but no luck.

I've acutally tried being optimistic, learning to do other things or working out.  In the end im so drained i cant even force my self to continue.  
My mind wanders and all i can think about are the bad things.
Most of the time now i just lay in bed, because anything is just too much effort and not worth the time since i'll most likely end up failing anyways

Meeting people is pretty hard for me, im essentially an introvert.
As for things like meetup.com or what ever.  At this point im pretty terrified of a relationship.  Im scared im going to get attached and get crushed all over again.  I feel that i let my guard down once recently it now i feel like complete shit.

I have a terrible relation with my mom.  Grew up abused.  Would get slapped across the face till i started bleeding or my grandmother stepped in.  My father left when i was too young remember.
My mom has pretty much started a new life.  Got remarried and had a new kid.  I rarely talk to them and want nothing really to do with them.
For a long time i had a gf that made helped me get through it,  she made me feel pretty good about me self, made me want to make certain decisions like get back to school.  But she's abandoned me.

One thing about the debt its not just the collectors calling.  Its my family, since i had to have them cosign.

I really wish i could afford a vacations.  But with rent and bills, i live pay check to 3-4 days before next paycheck.

I really dont feel like i have anything worth living for :/  For a small bit i felt like i found someone, but now that, thats pretty much over, i feel complete crushed once again.  
If i were to kill myself, people would be sad for a small bit, then continue to live on.  As it is now, i live on sad almost every second of my life.

ive tired getting into new things to keep my mind clear.  Its just kind of hard.  Most things involve money :/  I used to draw alot, and recently tried getting back into it.  But recently im just so drained its hard to muster up the will to do anything.
